description: This file defines API routes related to video management in a FastAPI application. It includes endpoints for listing videos, retrieving details of a specific video (including subtitles), uploading new videos, and streaming video content with support for HTTP Range requests.

methods.name: list_videos( session: AsyncSession = Depends(get_async_session), q: Optional[str] = Query(default=None, description="Optional search string to filter by title"), )
methods.description: Retrieves a list of videos, optionally filtered by a search query.

methods.name: get_video( video_id: int = FPath(..., description="ID of the video"), session: AsyncSession = Depends(get_async_session), request: Request = None, )
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information of a specific video, including associated subtitles.

methods.name: upload_video( title: str = Query(..., description="Title for the uploaded video"), description: Optional[str] = Query(default=None, description="Optional description"), file: UploadFile = File(..., description="Binary video file to upload"), session: AsyncSession = Depends(get_async_session), )
methods.description: Handles uploading of a new video file, saves it to disk, and creates a database record.

methods.name: stream_video( video_id: int = FPath(..., description="ID of the video to stream"), session: AsyncSession = Depends(get_async_session), request: Request = None, )
methods.description: Streams the binary content of a video with support for HTTP Range requests, enabling progressive loading.
